entries.title: Psalms 54:1
segments: ¶<<To the Chief Musician. With stringed instruments. A Contemplation of David when the Ziphites went and said to to Saul, "Is David not hiding with us?">> Save me, O God, by Your name, And vindicate me by Your strength.

entries.title: Psalms 54:2
segments: Hear my prayer, O God; Give ear to the words of my mouth.

entries.title: Psalms 54:3
segments: For strangers have risen up against me, And oppressors have sought after my life; They have not set God before them. Selah

entries.title: Psalms 54:4
segments: ¶Behold, God [is] my helper; The Lord [is] with those who uphold my life.

entries.title: Psalms 54:5
segments: He will repay my enemies for their evil. Cut them off in Your truth.

entries.title: Psalms 54:6
segments: I will freely sacrifice to You; I will praise Your name, O LORD, for [it is] good.

entries.title: Psalms 54:7
segments: For He has delivered me out of all trouble; And my eye has seen [its desire] upon my enemies.
